text:
sara_sales: Hey team — FinServCo wants SOC 2 + ISO excerpts for POC, plus a signed pen‑test letter. They also require network isolation for the staging POC (customer-managed proxy) and a hard deadline of next Friday for docs. Can we confirm what we can ship and what needs legal signoff? cc @maya @ira

jamie_se: quick note — for POC we usually provide: (1) SOC2 audit summary (redacted), (2) SOC control mapping sheet, (3) pen-test attestation letter (signed by legal), (4) staging creds + IP allowlist. timeline depends on legal for signing. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ira_security: We can produce the SOC2 mapping CSV and a redact-friendly snapshot; we don't give raw logs or private keys. For pen-test letter, security can draft a standard attestation. Need scope: is this an external red team on our infra or their endpoints? If external on our infra we need to confirm scope w/ legal. /cc @maya

maya_legal: Yes — pen-test letter requires narrow scope language + signatory. I can draft a template today but need PO/contract reference and the customer legal contact to sign. Also note: if they want a formal ISO27001 cert copy we provide the cert cover page + scope statement only. Anything more is NDAs/connector.

sara_sales: Customer says the test will be against the POC tenant only (staging env we spin up for them). They gave contact: alice@finserv.co. They also asked about dedicated pricing impact if we isolate (we might need reserved capacity). Can ops weigh in? Budget is tight, deadline is Fri.

ben_ops: Isolating a tenant into a staging VPC for a short POC is doable but adds infra ops hours + potential reserved GPU bump. Rough estimate: +$2k/week infra ops + possible reserved capacity delta depending on GPU footprint. I'll need expected peak QPS and sequence lengths. If they want ephemeral VPC staging we can use temporary routing + IP allowlist.

jamie_se: For docs we can assemble: `SOC2_mapping.csv`, `SOC2_summary.pdf (redacted)`, `pen_test_template.docx`, `staging-network-diagram.png`. I can start a pack in the shared drive. Link: https://redwood.ai/compliance/docs (internal)

maya_legal: I'll prepare the pen_test_template.docx and the required signatory block. Note we need to limit indemnities; standard language only. Send me the PO number and customer's legal contact ASAP.

sara_sales: PO is pending but procurement asked for a quote first. Customer willing to sign NDA if needed. I can ping procurement to fast-track PO. @jamie_se can you draft the network diagram template we can fill?

jamie_se: Yep — will drop an initial diagram and egg on Ben for the IP list. Expect first draft in 2 hours. :+1:

ira_security: Also request: temporary STAGING API keys should be time-limited (48h tokens) and rotated. We can't give long-lived keys or direct DB access. We'll provide a signed attestation that keys are ephemeral.

ben_ops: Agree. We'll provide ephemeral creds and a presigned upload for logs if they need evidence. Ops can do IP allowlist + short-lived creds. Need to know retention window for logs (customer asked for 90 days?). Ops default is 30 days for POC; can extend to 90 with ops cost.

sara_sales: Customer wants 90d logs. I'll flag cost. Also asks for a list of infra components in scope — can we produce a one-page list for procurement?

jamie_se: I'll produce "POC_scope_onepager.pdf" with components and assump. Will include estimated cost delta for isolation and 90d retention. Will call out that pen-test scope must be limited to POC tenant.

maya_legal: Requesting to route the pen-test letter through legal review. I'll need the draft, plus customer's legal contact (name + email), and the PO number once available. I can sign within 1 business day after review.

sara_sales: Pinged Alice at finserv — she replied with phone: +1-202-555-0118 and said procurement will push PO early next week. She confirmed POC tenant scope only. She also asked: can we redact customer names in SOC2 summary? customer is okay with redaction.

ira_security: Redaction is standard. We'll generate redacted SOC2 PDF. Also, if customer requests full reports we require SOC2 NDA + in-person review — mention that in scope doc.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: create-poc-tenant-provision at 3412345690 queued by jamie_se. Status: queued.

jamie_se: deploy-bot noted, I'll watch. Also dropping the initial diagram in drive: https://redwood.ai/drive/poc/finserv/diagram_v1.png

ben_ops: Added a note: for ephemeral creds we'll set TTL 48h and rotation every 24h. Also prepping cost estimate and will attach to the pack.

sara_sales: OK let's capture action items:
- jamie_se: network diagram + POC scope one-pager + initial doc pack (SOC2 redacted + mapping) — due EOD today
- maya_legal: pen-test template + sign-off timeline — due EOD tomorrow
- ben_ops: infra cost estimate for isolation + log retention cost — due tomorrow morning
- ira_security: verify attestation wording for ephemeral keys + SOC redaction — due EOD today
I'll follow up with customer and push for PO.

maya_legal: Sounds good. FYI — standard signatory is "Director of Legal" on our side. I'll loop in contracts if redlines appear.

alice@finserv.co: thanks all — procurement will aim to get PO by Monday. I can review pen-test scope once maya sends it. We prefer vendor-signed attestation rather than full audit. thx!

sara_sales: Great — thanks @alice and team. I'll update this thread when the PO lands. :rocket:
